import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Filter to significant features (p < 0.05)
    sig_idx = np.where(np.array([0.00037, 0.00095, 0.002, 0.0028, 0.011, 0.012, 0.013, 0.015, 0.024, 0.035, 
                                0.044, 0.046, 0.061, 0.063, 0.075, 0.081, 0.086, 0.095, 0.11, 0.15, 0.18, 0.18, 
                                0.19, 0.2, 0.23, 0.24, 0.27, 0.29, 0.33, 0.34, 0.37, 0.42, 0.42, 0.45, 0.45, 0.45, 
                                0.47, 0.47, 0.47, 0.51, 0.52, 0.52, 0.52, 0.52, 0.53, 0.53, 0.53, 0.51, 0.52, 0.58] 
                                ) < 0.05)[0]
    
    sig_ids = [feats.ids[i] for i in sig_idx]
    
    if len(sig_ids) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in sig_ids]].T)
    
    # Cluster features with high correlation (>0.6)
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=None, distance_threshold=1-0.6,
                                         linkage='average')
    cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(1 - np.abs(corr_matrix))
    
    # Find the largest cluster
    unique_labels, counts = np.unique(cluster_labels, return_counts=True)
    largest_cluster = unique_labels[np.argmax(counts)]
    module_features = [sig_ids[i] for i in range(len(sig_ids)) if cluster_labels[i] == largest_cluster]
    
    # If module size > 1, create weighted score
    if len(module_features) > 1:
        # Compute loadings using first principal component
        module_data = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in module_features]]
        _, _, v = np.linalg.svd(module_data, full_matrices=False)
        loadings = dict(zip(module_features, v[0]))
        
        # Return the module features and their loadings
        return Design(
            drivers=module_features[:MAX_DRIVERS],
            columns=module_features,
            products=(),
            loadings=loadings
        )
    
    # If no large cluster found, use top significant features
    top_features = sig_ids[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    return Design(
        drivers=top_features,
        columns=top_features,
        products=(),
        loadings={}
    )
